reported.quote: The AUM grew 14 .0% YoY and 11.4% QoQ, in line with the annual growth guidance, despite 7.6% write-offs made in FY26.
Disbursement in Q4 grew 28.4% YoY, and 44.1% QoQ to INR 8,313 Crore, while the full year disbursements came in at INR 24,859 Crore, up to 24.1%.

NIMs expanded by 35 bps QoQ to 14.2% in Q4.
PPOP grew 23.1% YoY and 14.7% QoQ to INR 780 Crore in Q4, while PAT grew over 6x YoY and 34.7% QoQ to INR 340 Crore, translating to an ROA of 4.4% and an ROE of 17.8%.

Gross NPA predominantly at 60 DPD, stood at 3.17%, net NPA at 1.12% and PAR 90 at 2.28%.
While our PPOP was in line with the budget, our credit cost ended at 6.74% as against the guidance of 5.5% to 6 .0%.
